name: @sand/pc-picker
description: Pick which PC a new thread runs on from the composer, continue a started thread on another PC, see whether each copy of the project is up to date, and send finished work to the other PCs

sand.label: PC picker
sand.summary: Choose which PC runs a thread or continue it on another PC, with sync status for each copy of the project

uses.sync: no up-to-date status and no offer to send changes before continuing
uses.syncFlows: a PC without a copy of the project can't get one when starting or continuing a thread
uses.notify: no messages about sending newer work or continuing threads
uses.picker: no folder prompt for threads outside a project and no prompt to send changes before continuing
